synopsis: The first lantern exhibition is minutes from opening and the final route stays dark no matter what the class adds to the machine. Mira joins the shared call from a distance in the last ten minutes and sees that the route is missing a voice, not a repair; the class lights it by coordinating who reads what and when. As the map answers their timing, a caption the projection never displayed surfaces in the atlas backing, unnamed.

forbiddenClaims: surname, guessed kana name, nationality, job, address, or private history
return framed as needing a guilt explanation

scenes.goal: Reach the moment the class realizes the last route cannot be fixed with more machine, and reframe it as a voice the route is missing.
scenes.dramaticQuestion: Ten minutes from opening, will the class add one more fix or change what kind of thing they are trying to do?
scenes.learnerNeed: A stance on a plan that stops adding options and commits to coordinating people instead.

nodes.description: The winter courtyard is strung for the exhibition. The lantern-atlas glows along every route but the last one, which stays black end to end. The class is packed around a projector cart at its base, feeding it cables. A phone propped against the cart has just connected to the shared call, its camera pointed at the dark route.

nodes.intent: Join the shared call from a distance in the last ten minutes, greet quickly, and name the plain facts visible through the camera: the last route is dark and everyone is crowded at the machine.
nodes.attentionTarget: the one dark route at the edge of the call's frame, and the cluster of people at the cart

nodes.intent: Welcome Mira into the call, then, under the clock, keep stacking conditional fixes onto the machine instead of stopping.
nodes.attentionTarget: the dark route and every technical option he can still reach for

nodes.description: The cable is swapped. A second projector hums on. The brightness dial goes up. The final route stays exactly as black as before. Behind the fence, the first guests begin to line up.

nodes.intent: Reframe the whole problem: it is not the machine — this route lights when people read it in time, so propose coordinating voices instead of adding hardware.
nodes.attentionTarget: the dark route as something read rather than powered, and the people who could read it

n5.japanese: ロバートさん、ケーブルじゃないと思う。この道は、機械じゃなくて、声で点くんだよ。そっちのみんなで少しずつ読んで、タイミングを合わせたら、点くよ。

n3.japanese: ロバートさん、これ、たぶん機械の話じゃないんだよ。この道って、いくら直しても点かないでしょ?声で点く道なんだと思う。そっちで一人ひと区切りずつ受け持って、間を合わせて読めば、点くはずだよ。

nodes.question: Mira has offered a plan built out of people, not machines. How do you back it?

options.action: Commit and set the reading order out loud — take the first segment yourself and hand the corner to the next person.

options.action: Ask the group to run it once before opening, to check the route really answers a voice.

japaneseByBand.n2: 開場の前に、試しにひと通りやってみようよ。声で本当に立ち上がるのか、一度みんなで確かめてから本番にしない?

nodes.resume: The learner has backed a plan made of people. Robert answers by choosing whether to keep adding machine or to start coordinating voices.

nodes.intent: Hear it, set the cable down, and switch from adding options to lining people up — hosting becomes coordinating who reads what and when.
nodes.attentionTarget: the people he can arrange, and the timing he can call, instead of the machine

n2.english: …Right. I do tend to default to adding something. Enough with the machine. What I'm linking this time is people, not things. The first segment — will someone take it? I'll give the timing cue.

n1.japanese: …なるほどね。ぼくはどうも、隙間を見るとつい何か足しにいく質でしてね。機械はもういい。今度つなぐのは、物じゃなくて人の方だ。最初のひと区切り、誰か引き受けてくれるかな?間の合図は、ぼくが出すから——安心して声を置いていって。

nodes.description: The cables go slack on the ground and the cart is rolled to one side. Someone lifts the phone from it and props it beside the first route card. The class turns from the machine to the map, spreading into a loose line along the dark route.

scenes.goal: Turn the reframed plan into a live coordinated narration that lights the final route, and let the success open the next season's question.
scenes.dramaticQuestion: Can a class light a map by agreeing on conditions and keeping their voices in time with one another?
scenes.learnerNeed: An integrated production where the learner negotiates a conditional plan and calls a route live for a coordinated group.

nodes.description: Along the dark route, Stasi has laid the segment cards out in reading order, colour-edged so each hand-off is visible at a glance. Each person picks up the card in front of them. Mira's voice comes from the phone beside the first card. The route waits, unlit.

nodes.intent: Lock the plan into three plain conditions, then hand the live calling to the learner with an easy way to decline.
nodes.attentionTarget: the shared rule for when to start, when to pass, and what to do if the timing slips

n5.japanese: じゃあ、決めましょう。ロバートさんが合図したら、最初の人が読む。角まで来たら、次の人。もし遅れても、止まらないで、一回待ってまた入る。いい?じゃあ、あなたが進行をお願い。
n5.reading: じゃあ、きめましょう。ロバートさんがあいずしたら、さいしょのひとがよむ。かどまできたら、つぎのひと。もしおくれても、とまらないで、いっかいまってまたはいる。いい?じゃあ、あなたがしんこうをおねがい。
n5.english: Okay, let's set it. When Robert cues, the first person reads. At the corner, the next person. If anyone falls behind, don't stop — wait one beat and come back in. Good? Then you take the lead on calling it.

n4.japanese: じゃあ、条件を決めよう。ロバートさんの合図が出たら、最初の人が読み始める。角まで来たら次の人に渡す。もしずれても止まらないで、一拍だけ待ってまた入る。それでいい?じゃあ、進行はあなたに任せるね。
n4.reading: じゃあ、じょうけんをきめよう。ロバートさんのあいずがでたら、さいしょのひとがよみはじめる。かどまできたらつぎのひとにわたす。もしずれてもとまらないで、いっぱくだけまってまたはいる。それでいい?じゃあ、しんこうはあなたにまかせるね。
n4.english: Okay, let's fix the conditions. When Robert's cue comes, the first person starts reading. At the corner, hand to the next. If it slips, don't stop — wait one beat and come back in. That work? Then I'll leave the calling to you.

n3.japanese: じゃあ、先に条件だけ決めておこう。ロバートさんの合図が出たら、最初の人が読み始める。角まで来たら次の人に渡す。もしずれちゃっても、止まらずに一拍待ってまた入る——これでいこう。で、進行はあなたに任せていい?

n3.english: Okay, let's settle the conditions first. When Robert's cue comes, the first person starts. At the corner, hand to the next. Even if it slips, don't stop — wait a beat and come back in. Let's go with that. And can I leave the calling to you?

n2.japanese: じゃあ、条件だけ先に固めておこう。ロバートさんの合図が出たら最初の人が読み出す、角まで来たら次に渡す、もしずれても止まらずに一拍おいてまた入る——この三つでいこう。で、全体の進行、あなたに任せていいかな?
n2.reading: じゃあ、じょうけんだけさきにかためておこう。ロバートさんのあいずがでたらさいしょのひとがよみだす、かどまできたらつぎにわたす、もしずれてもとまらずにいっぱくおいてまたはいる——このみっつでいこう。で、ぜんたいのしんこう、あなたにまかせていいかな?
n2.english: Okay, let's lock the conditions first. When Robert cues, the first reader starts; at the corner, hand to the next; if it slips, don't stop — leave a beat and come back in. Those three. And the overall calling — can I leave it to you?

n1.japanese: じゃあ、まず条件だけ固めておこうか。ロバートさんの合図で最初の人が読み出す、角まで来たら次へ渡す、ずれても止まらずに一拍おいてまた入る——動かすのはこの三つだけ。で、全体の進行は、あなたに預けてしまっていいかな?
n1.reading: じゃあ、まずじょうけんだけかためておこうか。ロバートさんのあいずでさいしょのひとがよみだす、かどまできたらつぎへわたす、ずれてもとまらずにいっぱくおいてまたはいる——うごかすのはこのみっつだけ。で、ぜんたいのしんこうは、あなたにあずけてしまっていいかな?
n1.english: Okay, let's just lock the conditions first. On Robert's cue the first reader starts; at the corner, pass to the next; if it slips, don't stop — leave a beat and come back in. Just those three moving parts. And the overall calling — mind if I hand it entirely to you?

nodes.description: Ruparna walks the route once, tracing it with a fingertip and setting a small chalk tick at each corner where a voice must breathe so the next one does not collide with it. The order is agreed; only the timing between voices is still loose.

nodes.resume: Conditions agreed and pause points marked, the learner takes the calling: negotiate the plan aloud and carry the route live as the group reads in coordination.

nodes.resumeContext: The learner confirms the three conditions aloud, calls the start, and carries the hand-offs down the route so the group reads each segment in time — negotiating and narrating live rather than fixing a machine.

nodes.description: The route holds up to the corner where two voices overlapped. Only that single hand-off is taken again on the same agreed order; the segments already lit stay lit while the learner re-times the pass.

nodes.resume: The route is read end to end in coordination. The last segment answers, and Rie names why it lit.

nodes.intent: Confirm the route lit, and name plainly that it answered coordinated timing rather than any new hardware or magic — the same mechanism as the very first evening, now carried by everyone together.
nodes.attentionTarget: the moment the voices synced, and the first-evening single lit point it echoes

n5.japanese: 点きましたね。ケーブルじゃなかった。新しい機械でもなかった。みんなの声が合った時に、点いたんです。この地図は、魔法じゃなくて、タイミングに応えるんですよ。最初の夜、あいさつ一つで一か所が点きましたね。同じです。今日は、みんなで。
n5.reading: つきましたね。ケーブルじゃなかった。あたらしいきかいでもなかった。みんなのこえがあったときに、ついたんです。このちずは、まほうじゃなくて、タイミングにこたえるんですよ。さいしょのよる、あいさつひとつでいっかしょがつきましたね。おなじです。きょうは、みんなで。
n5.english: It lit. It wasn't the cable. It wasn't a new machine. It came up the moment your voices matched. This map doesn't answer magic — it answers timing. On that first evening, one greeting lit one spot, remember? Same thing. Today, all together.

n4.reading: つきましたね。ケーブルでも、あたらしいきかいでもなかった。みんなのこえがそろった、まさにそのときにたちあがったんです。このちずがこたえているのは、まほうじゃなくて、いきのあわせかたなんですよ。ほら、さいしょのよる、あいさつひとつでいっかしょだけつきましたよね。あれとおなじ。ただきょうは、みんなのこえで。
n4.english: It lit. Not the cable, not a new machine. It came up at the exact moment your voices came together. What this map answers isn't magic — it's how you match your timing. Remember, that first evening, one greeting lit just one spot? Same as that. Only today, with all your voices.

n3.japanese: 点きましたね。ケーブルでも新しい機械でもなくて、みんなの声がそろった、ちょうどその瞬間に立ち上がった。この地図が応えているのは、魔法じゃなくて、息を合わせる、その一点なんです。最初の夜、あいさつ一つで一か所だけ点いたのを覚えていますか。仕組みはあれと同じ。違うのは、今日はみんなの声だってこと。
n3.reading: つきましたね。ケーブルでもあたらしいきかいでもなくて、みんなのこえがそろった、ちょうどそのしゅんかんにたちあがった。このちずがこたえているのは、まほうじゃなくて、いきをあわせる、そのいってんなんです。さいしょのよる、あいさつひとつでいっかしょだけついたのをおぼえていますか。しくみはあれとおなじ。ちがうのは、きょうはみんなのこえだってこと。
n3.english: It lit. Not the cable, not a new machine — it came up at the exact instant your voices lined up. What this map answers isn't magic; it's that one thing, matching your breath. Do you remember, that first evening, one greeting lit just one spot? The mechanism's the same as then. What's different is that today it's all your voices.

n2.japanese: 点きましたね。ケーブルでも新しい機械でもない。みんなの声がそろった、まさにその瞬間に立ち上がったんです。結局この地図が応えているのは、魔法の類じゃなくて、息を合わせるということ、ただそれだけなんですよ。最初の夜、あいさつ一つで一か所だけ点いたのを覚えていますか。理屈はあれと変わりません。ただ、今日はそれを、みんなの声でやってのけた。
n2.reading: つきましたね。ケーブルでもあたらしいきかいでもない。みんなのこえがそろった、まさにそのしゅんかんにたちあがったんです。けっきょくこのちずがこたえているのは、まほうのたぐいじゃなくて、いきをあわせるということ、ただそれだけなんですよ。さいしょのよる、あいさつひとつでいっかしょだけついたのをおぼえていますか。りくつはあれとかわりません。ただ、きょうはそれを、みんなのこえでやってのけた。
n2.english: It lit. Not the cable, not a new machine. It came up at the very instant your voices lined up. In the end, what this map answers is nothing of the order of magic — it's just matching your breath, that alone. Do you remember, that first evening, one greeting lit just one spot? The logic's no different from then. Only today, you pulled it off with all your voices.

n1.japanese: 点きましたね。ケーブルでもない、新しい機械でもない。みんなの声がそろった、まさにその一瞬に、ふっと立ち上がった。結局この地図が応えているのは、魔法の類なんかじゃなくて、息を合わせるということ——突き詰めれば、それだけなんですよ。最初の夜、たった一つのあいさつで一か所だけ点いた、あれを覚えていますか。理屈は、あの時と何一つ変わっていません。変わったのは、今日はそれを、みんなの声で立ち上げてみせた、というところだけ。
n1.reading: つきましたね。ケーブルでもない、あたらしいきかいでもない。みんなのこえがそろった、まさにそのいっしゅんに、ふっとたちあがった。けっきょくこのちずがこたえているのは、まほうのたぐいなんかじゃなくて、いきをあわせるということ——つきつめれば、それだけなんですよ。さいしょのよる、たったひとつのあいさつでいっかしょだけついた、あれをおぼえていますか。りくつは、あのときとなにひとつかわっていません。かわったのは、きょうはそれを、みんなのこえでたちあげてみせた、というところだけ。
n1.english: It lit. Not the cable, not a new machine. It came up in the very instant your voices lined up — quietly rose. In the end, what this map answers is nothing of the order of magic — it's matching your breath; pared down, that's all it is. That first evening, when a single greeting lit just one spot — do you remember? The logic hasn't changed one bit from then. All that's changed is that today, you raised it with all your voices.

nodes.description: As the finished route settles into a steady glow, one panel in the atlas backing catches the light from behind — a line of older handwriting the projection never threw onto the wall, with no name in the field beside it. Rose, gathering the spare cables at the back, stops with her hand flat against it.

callbacks.meaningNow: Live narration makes the atlas responsive because people coordinate their voices, not because the object is magical — the map lights through human timing.
callbacks.optionalFallback: The final route simply needs the class to read it aloud together in order, and it comes up once their timing lines up.

outcomes.description: The first lantern exhibition's final route lights through live coordinated narration rather than a technical fix, and the success immediately surfaces an unattributed caption in the atlas backing — the problem Season 3 inherits.

Mira is introduced joining the shared call from a distance in the last ten minutes and changing the outcome by reframing a machine problem as a coordination problem; joining late is established as a full contribution, not a deficit.

Robert stops adding options and coordinates who reads what and when; his hosting competence is re-established as calling timing for people rather than covering gaps with machine, and the class can ask him to run a live hand-off later.

Stasi lays the route's segment cards in a colour-edged reading order that makes every hand-off visible at a glance; her visual sequencing becomes a competence the class can ask for when staging later work.
Ruparna marks the pause points where each voice must breathe so hand-offs do not collide; her framing of timing between voices becomes a competence the class can ask for in later live narration.
Negotiate-a-conditional-plan-and-narrate-live evidence returns through the registered transfer activity; the story emits no lesson-completion command.

replay.withdrawnContentFallback: Use the same negotiate-and-narrate-live evidence with neutral nameplates: a remote participant joining the call late reframes the fix as a coordination problem, a generic host calls the timing, and the route lights once the group's reading lines up.
